notes.title: Version 1.102: Minor changes to the ending for new players
notes.content:
I've uploaded a new build of HANDMADEDEATHLABYRINTH issue 0.

[h2]If you've been defeated by HMDL-0 before and dread getting back into it[/h2]

About a month ago I posted a spoiler-full video of tips & tricks that'll get you past several of the obstacles you might have had some trouble with:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XiI3ldmhM4

It's a playful, deep exploration of several of the systems that make this game tick. A bit walkthrough, a bit developer commentary.

[h2]If you already own but haven't played HANDMADEDEATHLABYRINTH issue 0 yet[/h2]

What are you waiting for? :P
Don't watch my spoiler video, just give the game a try yourself first!
This is a good time to do it, since I've just fixed what I hope is the last semi-major design flaw with the game.

[h2]If you've played the game already[/h2]

1. Check out the [url=https://flamberge.bandcamp.com/album/hmdl-issue-0]soundtrack[/url]!

2. Leave a review here on Steam! I need those reviews!

Other than that, there's nothing left to do but wait for issue 1... No news yet, but I'll post an event once the engine gets moving again, sometime in very early 2021.

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

- Changed the ending slightly.
